entries.17f2276951a403c2: Staffing and Placement for the Real Estate Industry
entries.1a3f542ef1c23594: This business acquires income-producing properties such as residential properties, offices and commercial buildings, raises their income value by reviewing management costs and renovating, and sells them to investors and others. Amounts are disclosed collectively as the Real Estate Business, and amounts for each business are not printed separately.
entries.3106a4332a28b021: Staffing and Call Center Services for the Insurance and Financial Industries
entries.5210fef7de211524: This business develops urban residences, such as rental condominiums for single people and DINKS households, and sells them to real estate companies, business corporations, real estate investment funds, and customers for their own use. Amounts are disclosed collectively as the Real Estate Business, and amounts for each business are not printed separately.
entries.5b8aa347cacafd15: This business provides staffing for sales support roles such as outbound sales staff for insurance products, outsourced customer management clerical work, and dispatch of call center staff. Amounts are disclosed collectively as the Sales Promotion Business, and amounts for each business are not printed separately.
entries.8374118cc40472dc: This is a reportable segment that provides staffing and placement of sales support personnel and outsourced call center operations to the real estate, insurance and financial industries. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥3,936 million. The consolidated subsidiary Arushie Co., Ltd. handles this business.
entries.867b1f4b71cd9b9a: This is the reportable segment that develops urban residences, invests in and manages income-producing real estate, owns and operates hotels, provides solutions services, and conducts real estate brokerage and management in the Tokyo special wards and surrounding areas. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥74,569 million. It is handled by the company, ID Co., Ltd. and ID Property Co., Ltd.
entries.8a8cf3d3ac8dc62e: A company with a real estate business that develops rental residences and trades income-producing properties mainly in Tokyo's special wards, and a staffing business for the real estate, insurance and finance industries.
entries.b64afc06f293685f: This business provides staffing and placement services for sales support roles, such as staff at condominium model rooms and rental apartment leasing sites, and for clerical roles. Amounts are disclosed collectively as the Sales Promotion Business, and amounts for each business are not printed separately.
entries.b96e4668b7dec393: This business prepares land for development through demolition work, soil contamination surveys, adjustment of rights, obtaining permits and licenses, and similar work, and then sells the land. Amounts are disclosed collectively as the Real Estate Business, and amounts for each business are not printed separately.
entries.d4382cb8bdf0cb8b: Investment and Management of Income-Producing Real Estate
entries.fe85a00df06fc798: This business provides solution services related to real estate investment, development and management, real estate brokerage, and the ownership and operation of hotels. Amounts are disclosed collectively as the Real Estate Business, and amounts for each business are not printed separately.
